activities.name: Yukoro Onsen
activities.address: 204-7 Aza Yamada, Kutchan, Abuta District, Hokkaido 044-0081
activities.notes: Walk-in public onsen in Hirafu Village. Tattoos allowed. Indoor + small outdoor bath.

activities.name: Goshiki Onsen Ryokan
activities.address: 510 Aza Niseko, Niseko-cho, Abuta District, Hokkaido 048-1511
activities.notes: Remote sulphur-rich rotenburo in the mountains; magical in snow. Drive or taxi only.

activities.name: Tsuruga Besso Moku-no-Sho (day use onsen)
activities.notes: Upscale ryokan day-bath; large outdoor pools surrounded by forest.

activities.name: Hanazono Night Tubing
activities.address: Hanazono Resort base, 328 Aza-Iwaobetsu, Kutchan, Hokkaido
activities.notes: Lit snow-tubing lanes; good non-ski evening activity for families.

activities.name: Hanazono Snowmobile Tour
activities.address: Hanazono Resort base, 328 Aza-Iwaobetsu, Kutchan, Hokkaido
activities.notes: Guided snowmobile tours through Hanazono forests; multiple session lengths.

activities.name: Niseko Powder Connection (guided backcountry)
activities.notes: JMGA / IFMGA certified guides for sidecountry and backcountry days off Annupuri and Mt Yotei.

activities.name: GoSnow Ski & Snowboard School (Hanazono)
activities.notes: English-language ski/snowboard lessons; group and private. Kids program available.

activities.name: Niseko International Snowsports School (NISS)
activities.notes: Independent English-speaking school based in Hirafu, with kids' programs and adult clinics.

activities.name: Mt. Yōtei viewpoint
activities.notes: The 1,898 m 'Ezo Fuji' volcano; visible from most Hirafu lifts. Backcountry skiers tour it on clear days with a guide.
